title: Crew Revision Create Request
description: POST /api/v1/crews/{crew_id}/revisions. Creates the next immutable revision from the given bindings. A binding that contradicts an existing one yields 409 crew_binding_conflict; more than one entry binding yields 409 crew_entry_role_conflict.

agent_id.description: Bound agent; null only while state is unbound or for agent_unit rows.

unit_ref.description: Reserved (slice 4): versioned unit reference. Must be null in slices 1-3; a code identifier (GNFR-PRIV-003), never a display name.

pinned_agent_digest.description: Pinned agent build/config digest; null = follow the agent's latest.

entry.description: Entry role flag. At most one true per revision; exactly one is required before execution features.

bindings.description: Role bindings; role_id values must belong to this crew.
